# Folder Index

| Path | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [index.md](./index.md) | This folder inventory. |

Generated plugin archives such as `interview-prep-mcp-<version>.plugin.zip` are written here by `scripts/package_plugin.py` and ignored by git.

Generated submission packets such as `openai-submission-packet.json` are written here by `scripts/build_submission_packet.py` and ignored by git.

Generated MCP contract snapshots such as `mcp-contract-snapshot.json` are written here by `scripts/build_mcp_contract_snapshot.py` and ignored by git.
